derived_implementations.changes: Portable grouped-NetCDF interface, explicit mask and dates, temporary scratch order statistics, float64 calculations. variants.common_reference: evaluation.score: exact time/grid, common finite reference mask, every ensemble member finite, float32 member mean, no new postmean threshold; explicit symmetric units conversion.
variants.corrected_pair: historical/revision_matched/score_corrected_pair.py: exact eight-variable AORC truth, 200 timestamps, 4 members, generation/checkpoint/sampler configuration equality, humidity physical factor 0.1, pressure hPa.
variants.original_transfer: historical/aorc/score_netcdf_metrics_transfer.py: original default 0.1 mm postmean precipitation threshold; distinct from original synthetic scorer.
variants.FSS_table: Older score scripts: deterministic ensemble mean followed by >= threshold, zero-padded neighborhoods and mean of defined per-time scores.
variants.FSS_figures: Historical probabilistic FSS scripts: ensemble mean of binary exceedances, valid-support normalization, expanded valid centers, pooled time-space numerator/denominator.
variants.CRPS: Empirical ensemble CRPS, not fair CRPS.
variants.CSI: Inclusive >= threshold; no-events case is undefined.
variants.missing_values: Modern code rejects missing predictions inside common reference support. Historical variants retain their original handling.
